subject: design/feature-implementation-drive-local-git
statement: Accepted current evidence authorizes one final proposal from the feature branch to target main. It identifies exact F, M, C, scenario-set fingerprint, and complete accepted evidence. The drive requests or updates the proposal and observes results; it never approves or invokes landing.
